title: Bechtel and Monsanto possibly handling alien bodies and biological specimens

tellings.quote: I was also told that Monsanto may have historically been involved, most likely dealing with biological specimens.

plain: Big companies may have helped handle alien bodies and biological specimens in secure underground facilities: the engineering and construction firm Bechtel, and the chemical and farming company Monsanto, which Michels says was "most likely dealing with biological specimens." Michels tells this as something he was told, without saying who told him.
